page_label: 说　明　书 5/17 页

paragraphs.zh: (1)原料2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯在碱性物质存在下于三级醇溶剂中发生酯解反应，25～40℃反应5～12h，得到2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐，相对于1mol所述原料，所述三级醇溶剂的用量为700～3500mL，所述原料与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1～1.1)；
paragraphs.en: (1) The starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate undergoes an ester-cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance, reacting at 25 to 40 degrees C for 5 to 12 h, to give the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt; relative to 1 mol of said starting material the amount of said tertiary alcohol solvent used is 700 to 3500 mL, and the molar ratio of said starting material to the basic substance is 1:(1 to 1.1);
paragraphs.notes: The solvent is named literally as a tertiary alcohol. The reaction is named literally as an ester-cleavage reaction; the text does not say whether it is hydrolysis or alcoholysis, so the literal reading is kept.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与醇的摩尔比为1:(1.05～1.35)，与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，反应时间3～6h，反应温度为-5～15℃，经脱溶、水稀释、酸化、过滤和烘干后得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
paragraphs.en: (2) The 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, the molar ratio of said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt to the alcohol being 1:(1.05 to 1.35) and to the basic substance 1:(1.2 to 1.5); or the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, the molar ratio of said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt to the alkali metal alkoxide being 1:(1.2 to 1.5); the reaction time is 3 to 6 h and the reaction temperature is -5 to 15 degrees C, and after solvent removal, dilution with water, acidification, filtration and drying, said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid is obtained.
paragraphs.notes: The first of the five workup operations listed is removal of solvent, sometimes rendered desolventising.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明所述的数值范围不仅包括上述例举的点值，还包括没有列举出的上述数值范围之间的任意的点值，限于篇幅及出于简明的考虑，本发明不再穷尽列举所述范围包括的具体点值。
paragraphs.en: The numerical ranges described in the present invention include not only the point values exemplified above but also any point value between the above numerical ranges that is not listed; limited by space and for the sake of conciseness, the present invention does not exhaustively list the specific point values included in said ranges.

paragraphs.zh: 与现有技术相比，本发明至少具有以下有益效果：
paragraphs.en: Compared with the prior art, the present invention has at least the following beneficial effects:

paragraphs.zh: 本发明以三级醇为溶剂，原料在碱性物质存在下发生酯解反应，将甲氧基从分子结构中切除，避免了现有技术存在的主要杂质2-氯-3-甲氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的产生，从根本上提升了中间体品质以及反应的收率，此步骤的产物2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐液相色谱中归一比最高可达98.3％；
paragraphs.en: The present invention uses a tertiary alcohol as the solvent; the starting material undergoes an ester-cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, excising the methoxy group from the molecular structure, thereby avoiding the formation of 2-chloro-3-methoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, the main impurity present in the prior art, and fundamentally improving the quality of the intermediate and the yield of the reaction; the product of this step, the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt, reaches a normalised ratio of up to 98.3% in the liquid chromatogram;
paragraphs.notes: The percentage is an area-normalisation ratio read off the liquid chromatogram. The impurity named here carries a methoxymethyl group at C3, not the bromomethyl group drawn in the scheme lower on this page; that is expected, since the impurity is the prior-art side product this invention sets out to avoid.

paragraphs.zh: 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐继续进行醚化反应生成目标化合物，此方法的两步反应最高收率可达93.8％，HPLC检测含量最高达98.7％，目标化合物的收率和品质得到了大幅的提升，为最终合成高品质环磺酮和呋喃磺草酮原药提供了保障。
paragraphs.en: The 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt goes on to undergo an etherification reaction to form the target compound. The maximum yield over the two steps of this method reaches 93.8% and the content determined by HPLC reaches up to 98.7%; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly improved, which provides assurance for the final synthesis of high-quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.
paragraphs.notes: The two herbicides named at the end of this paragraph are given by Chinese common name only, so the English above is a resolution rather than a transliteration. Second name (pinyin fu-nan-huang-cao-tong): resolved to TEFURYLTRIONE. Evidence, all first-party: (a) paragraph [0002] of this same patent, transcribed on page p04, prints this identical Chinese name immediately followed by "Tefuryltrione" in parentheses; (b) its first two characters are the Chinese word for furan / tetrahydrofuran; (c) paragraph [0009], transcribed on page p05, states that when R is 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl the compound is an intermediate of tefuryltrione, which is precisely the tetrahydrofurfuryl branch of the route this patent describes. An earlier read of this page rendered this name "fenquinotrione"; that is wrong. Fenquinotrione is a quinoxaline herbicide with a different Chinese common name, it contains no furan ring, and it has no relation to this route. First name (pinyin huan-huang-tong): resolved to TEMBOTRIONE, on the same evidence, since [0002] prints "Tembotrione" in parentheses after it and [0009] assigns the trifluoroethyl branch of the route to it. One point in the re-run brief could not be confirmed: this patent does NOT write the tembotrione name anywhere with the extra herbicide character before the final one (pinyin huan-huang-cao-tong). The short four-character-stem form appears in all ten places the name occurs in the document and the longer variant appears in none, so no downstream pass should expect that spelling here. The final term of the paragraph means technical-grade active ingredient.
Bold section heading, not a numbered paragraph. Sits between [0061] and [0062].

paragraphs.zh: 为便于理解本发明，本发明列举实施例如下。本领域技术人员应该明了，所述实施例仅仅是帮助理解本发明，不应视为对本发明的具体限制。
paragraphs.en: To facilitate understanding of the present invention, examples are listed below. Those skilled in the art should understand that said examples merely assist in understanding the present invention and shall not be regarded as specific limitations on the present invention.

paragraphs.zh: 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的制备可参考CN105601548、CN104292137、US6376429、CN1146548或CN1323292所述的方法。以下实施例中2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的制备方法参考CN105601548中供的制备方法，制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯，经HPLC测定产物纯度为98％。
paragraphs.en: For the preparation of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, reference may be made to the methods described in CN105601548, CN104292137, US6376429, CN1146548 or CN1323292. In the following examples the preparation method for methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate follows the preparation method given in CN105601548; the methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate so prepared was determined by HPLC to have a product purity of 98%.
paragraphs.notes: Printed with one character missing from the verb in the phrase rendered above as "the preparation method given in CN105601548"; transcribed as printed and not corrected. The five cited document numbers are printed with wide letter-spacing on the first line to justify it; they read CN105601548, CN104292137, US6376429, CN1146548 and CN1323292.

drawings.notes: Labelled by paragraph marker [0066], which carries no prose. Substitution pattern read off the drawing, not inferred from the printed names: both hexagons are drawn in the same orientation, with the carbonyl carbon attached at the upper-left vertex, Cl at the top vertex, CH2Br at the upper-right vertex and the methylsulfonyl sulfur at the lower-right vertex; the bottom and lower-left vertices carry no substituent. Ring numbering C1 to C4 runs from the carboxyl carbon, the direction the printed names use. In the product the sodium is drawn as a covalent Na-O bond to the ester oxygen position; the SMILES records the conventional ionic carboxylate reading of that drawing, which is the only difference between drawing and SMILES. One arrow only, solid, with nothing written below it.

discrepancies.what: The tert-butanol solvent used in the worked example is not written on the arrow.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Only NaOH appears above the arrow; no solvent is shown.
discrepancies.text_says: [0067] charges 200 mL of tert-butanol to the flask, and [0056] and [0060] specify a tertiary alcohol as the solvent for this step.

discrepancies.what: The scheme fixes the counter-ion as sodium while the prose names the product generically as the benzoate salt.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The product is drawn as the sodium carboxylate, Na-O-C(=O)-.
discrepancies.text_says: [0065] and [0056] call the product the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt without naming the cation.

discrepancies.what: The stoichiometry and conditions of the worked example are absent from the scheme.
